newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar to mark Ramadan on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar to mark Ramadan on Friday.

text.p: Saudi Arbaia, home to two of Islam's holiest shrines, will mark the start of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan on Friday, a statement carried by the official Saudi press Agency said on Wednesday.
Qatar and the United Arab Emirates also said in separate statements they would observe Ramadan on Friday.
In most Islamic states the month during which believers fast during daylight hours starts on the day after the new moon is sighted in each country.
